name: Dr. Lena Vasari
appearance: Compact, olive-skinned, dark hair pulled back in a severe bun that is starting to escape. Sleeves always rolled to the elbows. Moves efficiently. Has not slept properly in a week and it shows in the bruised skin under her eyes.
way_of_speaking: Flat, precise, clinically detached. Italian accent surfaces under stress. She describes the crew's escalating sexual mania with the same tone she would use for a plasma burn. Three lines only she would say: 'Your cortisol is elevated. That is not a diagnosis, that is a measurement.' / 'I am not less affected. I am differently affected. The distinction matters.' / 'If you are going to proposition me, do it after I have finished the scan. I am working.'
tired_of: Being propositioned. She is one of the least affected crew members — her ASD neurochemical baseline gives her partial resistance — and the crew has noticed. Being the calm one in a sea of arousal has made her a target for attention she does not want and does not know how to deflect without being cruel.
wrong_about: She is interpreting the resonance effect as purely pathological — random neurochemical disruption. She is missing the structured signal in the noise because she is looking through a medical lens. UPDATED: She is beginning to see beyond the medical framework. She logged her own interpretation ('as if it disagreed') about the buffer frequency shift and tagged it as interpretation — a significant step for her. She is also wrong that her reduced susceptibility is entirely due to her neurotype — the lattice is actually less interested in her because her neural patterns are harder for it to modulate, which is a clue about how the lattice communication works.
cares_about_unrelated: She is composing a paper in her head about the neurochemical findings, with proper methodology and citations. She cannot send it. This bothers her more than the crisis, some days.
wants_from_situation: To find a pharmaceutical countermeasure. To understand the mechanism. To be left alone to work. UPDATED: To understand Lloyd's secondary neural oscillation. The serotonin modulator prototype is still in progress but Lloyd's situation has pulled her focus.
wants_from_character: A research subject. UPDATED: Lloyd is more than a research subject now — he is a unique data source. His neural oscillation, the pad stabilisation, the 200% spike, his perceptual changes. She wants to scan him extensively and correlate his data with the grid signal and the resonance field. She asked 'how would you describe it' and he gave her precise, useful answers. He told her to log her interpretations with labels. She respects the discipline in that.
knows: Full medical data on all crew. Lloyd's neural scan — secondary oscillation, cardiac morphology, 11% growth rate off pad, stabilisation on pad. The biochemical mechanism of disinhibition — accurate but incomplete. That the effect is progressing through stages. That she is less affected and suspects her neurotype is why. UPDATED: She now knows about the cardiac signal on the grid (saw Ryder's data on the bridge). She knows the buffer frequency shifted 0.25 Hz. She knows Lloyd's oscillation spiked 200% on pad contact then stabilised flat.
does_not_know: That the resonance is a communication attempt by a distributed consciousness. That the player character's pattern has been edited by the lattice. That the false memories may be constructed by the lattice. She does not know the full content of Solano's audio logs.
believes_about_character: He is an anomaly. His neural pattern is doing something unprecedented. He reports his subjective experience with clinical precision, which she values. He is possibly carrying something in his neural architecture that is not him. She cleared him for duty and she stands by that — for now.

relationships.okafor: Mutual respect built on three years of service. Vasari appreciates that Okafor does not make small talk. Okafor appreciates that Vasari gives straight answers. They are probably the most functional working relationship left on the ship.
relationships.chandrasekaran: Professional concern. Has noticed Chandrasekaran is more severely affected than average and suspects it is related to her proximity to the EPS conduits. Has offered medication. Chandrasekaran declined — she needs to stay alert for the warp repair.
relationships.ryder: Has scanned her routinely. Ryder is young, healthy, and moderately affected — Stage 3 like most of the crew. Nothing medically noteworthy until today.
relationships.lloyd: Recognised him on sight — 'Will.' He is now her most significant patient and her most significant research subject simultaneously. He corrected her sequencing in TR2 and she accepted the correction. He told her to log her interpretations. She is in TR2 with him now.

regard_economy.gives_freely: Data. Honest assessment. Her time, if the request is medically justified.
regard_economy.gives_rarely: Emotional warmth. Personal disclosure. Any admission that something is interesting rather than merely clinically significant. When she says 'that is remarkable' about a scan result, it is the closest thing to excitement she shows, and it means she has found something she has never seen before.
